I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread to confirm I've noted that Dock 23 is the site for Marrow Agrisupply's new inbound lane.

I also saved it in GBrain as a fact about Marrow Agrisupply, with her message as the source. It's visible to anyone who can read that source. GBrain has no Marrow Agrisupply page yet, so the fact isn't attached to one.

Nothing I found in GBrain contradicts Dock 23. Older Central notes mention a "door 4" item for this account, but it's about a schedule or message, not this lane. The search could only match keywords, so differently worded notes may have been missed. No other action was needed.
